[EN] There was a misunderstanding.

I thought that the raiders were trying to make use of the phenomenon to attack...

But they were too suspicious all along.
[ES] Hubo un malentendido.

Pensé que los asaltantes estaban intentando aprovechar el fenómeno para atacar...

Pero fueron demasiado sospechosos todo este tiempo.

[EN] Trust instead.
[ES] Confía en en su lugar.

[EN] We will investigate your claims, Hennika. Pray your story checks out.
[ES] Investigaremos tus afirmaciones, Hennika. Ruega que tu historia sea cierta.
